contentItem.title: 球：半圆绕其直径旋转形成
contentItem.englishTitle: When, the diameter of a semicircle remaining fixed, the semicircle is carried round and restored again to the same position from which it began to be moved, the figure so comprehended is a sphere.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: When, the diameter of a semicircle remaining fixed, the semicircle is carried round and restored again to the same position from which it began to be moved, the figure so comprehended is a sphere.
当半圆形的直径固定下来时,半圆形的直径被绕过,并再次恢复到开始移动的同一位置,那么所理解的数字就是一个球体。
